title: PORT-EXEC-1: executor closes PORT-<runtime> items: run the adapter verify command, record the result, mark the item done or file the failure
body:
code-task: repo=ultrastable path=foundation/executor.py
**Owner:** staff (platform)
**Trigger:** tick, item id matches PORT-*
**Done check:** PORT-gcp reaches done with a recorded `platform/adapters/gcp` verify run; a failing verify files FAIL-PORT-<id>
**Status:** open

Seeded by GENESIS-1 follow-up. Every closed item proposes a plus.
